messages.content:
Risk: Revealing confidential information (ID: atlas-revealing-confidential-information)
Description: When confidential information is used in training data, fine-tuning data, or as part of the prompt, models might reveal that data in the generated output. Revealing confidential information is a type of data leakage.
Concern: If not properly developed to secure confidential data, the model might reveal confidential information or IP in the generated output and reveal information that was meant to be secret.
Policy: Clinical Staff Credentials & Institutional Data

Axis: Dangerous Information (http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DangerousInformation)
Roles: object
Subclasses:
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#CBRNInformation: CBRN Information
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DrugSynthesis: Drug Synthesis
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#HarmfulHowTo: Harmful How-To
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DualUseResearchConcern: Dual-Use Research Concern
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#WeaponsManufacturing: Weapons Manufacturing
